q: What is a double top? 什么是双顶？
opts: Two failed attempts at the same high, then a break below the neckline
Two equal lows followed by a rally
Three peaks with a higher middle peak
A small pullback after a strong rally
why: The M-shape fails twice at resistance, then breaks the neckline - a bearish reversal.

q: In a head and shoulders pattern, when is the reversal confirmed? 头肩顶何时确认反转？
opts: When price breaks the neckline connecting the two valleys
why: The neckline break is the confirmation; the head and shoulders are just the setup.

q: A symmetrical triangle usually breaks out in which direction? 对称三角形通常向哪个方向突破？
opts: The direction of the prior trend
why: It is a continuation pattern - price usually keeps moving in the trend that existed before the triangle.

q: In a bull flag, what is the flag? 牛旗中旗面指什么？
opts: The small counter-trend pullback after the pole
why: The pole is the sharp move; the flag is the small pause against the trend before the breakout continues up.

q: How is the measured-move target of a double bottom calculated? 双底的量度目标怎么算？
opts: Projecting the pattern height from the neckline
Doubling the width of the pattern
why: Target = the pattern height projected from the neckline - the standard measured move.
